verses.sloka: तमुद्वीक्ष्य महाबाहुः पिङ्गाक्षं पुरतः स्थितम् ।कोपेन महता ऽ ऽविष्टो रावणो लोकरावणः ।। ५.५०.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamudvīkṣya mahābāhuḥ piṅgākṣaṁ purataḥ sthitam ।kopena mahatā ' 'viṣṭo rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.50.1।।।।

translations.english: The mighty armed Ravana, a tormentor of all worlds, overcome with anger beheld the tawnyeyed brilliant lord of monkeys who stood before him and started thinking in his mind full of apprehensions.
translations.hindi: मनोरथ सिद्ध हो जाने से हनुमानजी उत्साहित हुए । वह लंका की घ्रोर देख, मन ही मन शेष कत्तव्य को विचारने लगे

verses.sloka: शङ्काहतात्मा दध्यौ स कपान्द्रं तेजसावृतम् ।किमेष भगवान्नन्दी भवेत् साक्षादिहागतः ।। ५.५०.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaṅkāhatātmā dadhyau sa kapāndraṁ tejasāvṛtam ।kimeṣa bhagavānnandī bhavet sākṣādihāgataḥ ।। 5.50.2।।।।

translations.english: 'Is he Lord Nandi who came here in person? I was earlier cursed by him when I shook the mount Kailasa in the past. Could he have assumed a monkeyform or may be he is the great demon Bana. (Nandi is the bull, the vehicle of Lord Siva).
translations.hindi: कपि ने विचारा कि, में अब क्या करूं जिससे राक्षसों के मन में प्रौर अधिक संताप उत्पन्न हो

verses.sloka: येन शप्तो ऽस्मि कैलासे मया सञ्चालिते पुरा ।सो ऽयं वानरमूर्तिः स्यात् किंस्विद्बाणोपि वा ऽसुरः ।। ५.५०.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: yena śapto 'smi kailāse mayā sañcālite purā ।so 'yaṁ vānaramūrtiḥ syāt kiṁsvidbāṇopi vā 'suraḥ ।। 5.50.3।।।।

translations.english: 'Is he Lord Nandi who came here in person? I was earlier cursed by him when I shook the mount Kailasa in the past. Could he have assumed a monkeyform or may be he is the great demon Bana. (Nandi is the bull, the vehicle of Lord Siva).
translations.hindi: इस बीच में, मेने रावण का प्रमदावन को उजाइ डाला, बड़े-बड़े नामी वीर राक्षसों को मार डाला, सेना का एक बड़ा भाग भी नष्ट कर डाला; प्रब तो मुझे रावण के दुगं का नाश करना श्रौर बाकी रह गया है

verses.sloka: स राजा रोषताम्राक्षः प्रहस्तं मन्त्रिसत्तमम् ।कालयुक्तमुवाजेदं वचो विपुलमर्थवत् ।। ५.५०.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa rājā roṣatāmrākṣaḥ prahastaṁ mantrisattamam ।kālayuktamuvājedaṁ vaco vipulamarthavat ।। 5.50.4।।।।

translations.english: The infuriated demon king told the great minister Prahasta, these profound words in a brief manner appropriate to the hour.
translations.hindi: प्रतः, दुर्ग के नाश करने से मेरा परिश्रम सफल हो जायगा श्रौर इसे उजाइने में मुझे उहुत-सा श्रम भी न उठाना पड़ेगा । थोड़े ही परिश्रम से यह काम भी पुरा हो जायगा

verses.sloka: दुरात्मा पृच्छ्यतामेष कुतः किं वा ऽस्य कारणम् ।वनभङ्गे च को ऽस्यार्थो राक्षसीनां च तर्जने ।। ५.५०.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: durātmā pṛcchyatāmeṣa kutaḥ kiṁ vā 'sya kāraṇam ।vanabhaṅge ca ko 'syārtho rākṣasīnāṁ ca tarjane ।। 5.50.5।।।।

translations.english: "Enquire from this wicked one, why he has come and from where, Why he destroyed the garden and for what purpose he threatened the demonesses?

verses.sloka: मत्पुरीमप्रधृष्यां वा ऽ ऽगमने किं प्रयोजनम् ।आयोधने वा किं कार्यं त्वया कपे ।। ५.५०.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: matpurīmapradhṛṣyāṁ vā ' 'gamane kiṁ prayojanam ।āyodhane vā kiṁ kāryaṁ tvayā kape ।। 5.50.6।।।।

translations.english: "Enquire why this wicked one entered this inviolable city and for what purpose did he wage a war"

verses.sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्तो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते न भीः कार्या त्वया कपे ।। ५.५०.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasto vākyamabravīt ।samāśvasihi bhadraṁ te na bhīḥ kāryā tvayā kape ।। 5.50.7।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Ravana, Prahasta spoke these words boosting the monkey's morale 'O monkey Be relaxed. Feel safe. You need not entertain any fear.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी राक्षसों के एक घर से दूसरे घर पर ग्रौर दूसरे से तीसरे घर प्र चढ़ जाते प्रौर निर्भय हो, वहाँ के उद्यानों को देखते थ

verses.sloka: यदि तावत्त्वमिन्द्रेण प्रेषितो रावणालयम् ।तत्त्वमाख्याहि मा भूत्ते भयं वानर मोक्ष्यसे ।। ५.५०.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi tāvattvamindreṇa preṣito rāvaṇālayam ।tattvamākhyāhi mā bhūtte bhayaṁ vānara mokṣyase ।। 5.50.8।।।।

translations.english: "Have you came to the abode of Ravana sent by Indra? Speak the truth. Be not afraid.You will be released".

verses.sloka: यदि वैश्रवणस्य त्वं यमस्य वरुणस्य च ।चाररूपमिदं कृत्वा प्रविष्टो नः पुरीमिमाम् ।विष्णुना प्रेषितो वापि दूतो विजयकाङ्क्षिणा ।। ५.५०.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi vaiśravaṇasya tvaṁ yamasya varuṇasya ca ।cārarūpamidaṁ kṛtvā praviṣṭo naḥ purīmimām ।viṣṇunā preṣito vāpi dūto vijayakāṅkṣiṇā ।। 5.50.9।।।।

translations.english: Have you, assuming this form, entered our city as a spy of Kubera, Yama or Varuna, or perhaps as a messenger sent by Vishnu who longs for victory?
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार निश्चय कर दामिनीयुक्त मेघ की तरह, जलती हुई पूछ को लिए हुए, हनुमानजी भवनों की झटारियों पर [ या छज्जा पर ] घूमने बगे

verses.sloka: न हि ते वानरं तेजो रूपमात्रं तु वानरम् ।। ५.५०.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi te vānaraṁ tejo rūpamātraṁ tu vānaram ।। 5.50.10।।।।

translations.english: "Your appearance is only of that of a vanara. But your glow is not of a vanara indeed. Tell the truth today. You will be set free.

verses.sloka: तत्त्वतः कथयस्वाद्य ततो वानर मोक्ष्यसे ।अनृतं वदतश्चापि दुर्लभं तव जीवितम् ।अथवा यन्निमित्तं ते प्रवेशो रावणालये ।। ५.५०.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: tattvataḥ kathayasvādya tato vānara mokṣyase ।anṛtaṁ vadataścāpi durlabhaṁ tava jīvitam ।athavā yannimittaṁ te praveśo rāvaṇālaye ।। 5.50.11।।।।

translations.english: "If you tell a lie, it will be difficult for you to live. Or else, tell me for what reason have you entered the abode of Ravana.'

The foremost of the vanaras spoke to the lord of ogres in response to the equiries made to him: "I have not come from Indra or Yama or Varuna. I have no friendship with Kubera. I have not been sent by Visnu. By birth I am vanara and I have come here.'

verses.sloka: अब्रवीन्नास्मि शक्रस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा ।धनदेन न मे सख्यं विष्णुना नास्मि चोदितः ।। ५.५०.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: abravīnnāsmi śakrasya yamasya varuṇasya vā ।dhanadena na me sakhyaṁ viṣṇunā nāsmi coditaḥ ।। 5.50.13।।।।

translations.english: The foremost of the vanaras spoke to the lord of ogres in response to the equiries made to him: "I have not come from Indra or Yama or Varuna. I have no friendship with Kubera. I have not been sent by Visnu. By birth I am vanara and I have come here.'

verses.sloka: जातिरेव मम त्वेषा वानरो ऽहमिहागतः ।दर्शने राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दुर्लभे तदिदं मया ।। ५.५०.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: jātireva mama tveṣā vānaro 'hamihāgataḥ ।darśane rākṣasendrasya durlabhe tadidaṁ mayā ।। 5.50.14।।।।

translations.english: An audience with the lord of demons being hard to obtain, I destroyed this garden of the demon king in order to gain a sight of him.

verses.sloka: वनं राक्षसराजस्य दर्शनार्थे विनाशितम् ।ततस्ते राक्षसाः प्राप्ता बलिनो युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ५.५०.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: vanaṁ rākṣasarājasya darśanārthe vināśitam ।tataste rākṣasāḥ prāptā balino yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 5.50.15।।।।

translations.english: "Desiring to fight with me the powerful ogres came. Then I fought in self defence.

verses.sloka: रक्षणार्थं तु देहस्य प्रतियुद्धा मया रणे ।अस्त्रपाशैर्न शक्यो ऽहं बद्धुं देवासुरैरपि ।। ५.५०.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣaṇārthaṁ tu dehasya pratiyuddhā mayā raṇe ।astrapāśairna śakyo 'haṁ baddhuṁ devāsurairapi ।। 5.50.16।।।।

translations.english: "It is not possible to bind me with any bondage of astras even by devas or danavas. Such a boon has been granted to me by Grandfather Brahma.
translations.hindi: रावण के भेरुपर्वत के समान विशाल मुख्य भवन में, जो विविध प्रकार के रत्नों से भूषित था प्रौर समस्त माङ्गलिक द्रव्यों से परिपूर्ण था,

verses.sloka: पितामहादेव वरो ममाप्येषो ऽभ्युपागतः ।राजानं द्रष्टुकामेन मयास्त्रमनुवर्तितम् ।। ५.५०.१७।।।।

translations.english: "Wishing to see the king I honoured this astra and not otherwise. Even though I was tormented by the ogres and released by the astra I submitted to you as I have a small work assigned by the king.
translations.hindi: लंकापुरी निवासी घनो राक्षसों के घरों में जो-जो मूल्यवान भ्रश्न, वस्त्र, द्रव्य भादि सामग्री थी, हनुमानजी ने उस सब को भस्म कर डाला

verses.sloka: विमुक्तो ह्यहमस्त्रेण राक्षसैस्त्वभिपीडितः ।केनचिद्राजकार्येण संप्राप्तो ऽस्मि तवान्तिकम् ।। ५.५०.१८।।।।

translations.english: "Wishing to see the king I honoured this astra and not otherwise. Even though I was tormented by the ogres and released by the astra I submitted to you as I have a small work assigned by the king.

verses.sloka: दूतो ऽहमिति विज्ञेयो राघवस्यामितौजसः ।श्रूयतां चापि वचनं मम पथ्यमिदं प्रभो ।। ५.५०.१९।।
verses.transliteration: dūto 'hamiti vijñeyo rāghavasyāmitaujasaḥ ।śrūyatāṁ cāpi vacanaṁ mama pathyamidaṁ prabho ।। 5.50.19।।

translations.english: Know that I am a messenger of the highly powerful Rama. O lord please listen to these beneficial words of mine meant for your welfare. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
